gen-gf-grandstander-fs-familjen-grotesk: Glowing, tube-like and loud: Grandstander draws its heading in one constant line. Familjen Grotesk follows in a lively sans with tall lowercase, giving the shouty top a talkative, easygoing partner underneath.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-hind: Gugi stands out with tall lowercase that nearly touches its capitals. Hind sits beside it as a sans with a steady, drawn-string stroke, so the pairing feels distinctive up top and quietly dependable below.
gen-gf-metamorphous-satoshi: Satoshi brings a soaring x-height and a wide, unsqueezed e, all in one constant line width. Metamorphous is best at its shimmer of fat and slim strokes across the words, while Satoshi does its best work being straightforward and open.
gen-gf-paprika-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its c tips well apart and its line holding one width from start to finish. Paprika is best when its lowercase fills the line like capitals, while Work Sans does its best work as a modern, contemporary sans with a high mean line.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-epilogue: A lowercase g with an open lower curve and a relaxed stride across widely separated letters set Revalia apart. Epilogue is the plain sans that stays gentle and wire-thin below.
gen-gf-warnes-switzer: Warnes spreads its stretched, spacious letters in ink strokes that taper out before touching. Switzer follows as a plain sans, tubular and wire-like, and its approachable Swiss tidiness is the pair's finest quality.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-amulya: Open-curved and pen-simple, Phudu has horizontals no thinner than its verticals. Amulya keeps the same generous gaps in its curves, and that shared openness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-chillax: Chillax reads casual and relaxed, like spaghetti laid out in letters with loops left unfinished. Phudu holds the top with bold, open-ended curves, while Chillax loosens the page below it in a looser, friendlier sans.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-plein: Bold and open-curved, Phudu looks traced with a single marker tip. Plein does its best work below as a reliable, clean sans, with a clear channel leading into each round letter.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-spline-sans: Generous openings on every curve, drawn in a ballpoint's plain line, mark Phudu. Spline Sans shares that spaciousness, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems, so the two feel like one friendly voice at different volumes.
